entities.summary: Manuel Linares-Rivas (b. 1866-02-08, Santiago de Compostela) was a journalist or media commentator of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Santiago de Compostela and Spain. Known in the fields of spain, poets & playwrights, europe.
